articles.title: Brain cells meant to protect us may be fueling cognitive decline

paras.en: Brain cells meant to protect us may be fueling cognitive decline
paras.zh: 旨在保护我们的脑细胞可能会加剧认知能力下降

paras.en: - Scientists have uncovered a surprising cause of age-related cognitive decline involving brain cells previously thought to be entirely beneficial. As these cells become dysfunctional, they can produce abnormal amounts of myelin, disrupting nerve fibers and potentially contributing to worsening memory and thinking skills.
paras.zh: - 科学家们发现了与年龄相关的认知能力下降的一个令人惊讶的原因，该原因涉及先前被认为完全有益的脑细胞。当这些细胞功能失调时，它们会产生异常数量的髓磷脂，破坏神经纤维，并可能导致记忆力和思维能力恶化。

paras.en: Brain cells that normally help protect the brain may play an unexpected role in cognitive decline as we grow older. Scientists have discovered that cells responsible for maintaining the protective coating around nerve fibers can become dysfunctional with age, potentially contributing to the gradual loss of memory and thinking abilities.
paras.zh: 随着年龄的增长，通常有助于保护大脑的脑细胞可能会在认知能力下降中发挥意想不到的作用。科学家发现，负责维持神经纤维周围保护层的细胞会随着年龄的增长而变得功能失调，可能导致记忆和思维能力逐渐丧失。

paras.en: The research, published in Nature Medicine, challenges the long-held belief that these cells are always beneficial. By examining human brain tissue and conducting experiments in mice, researchers found evidence that problems with these normally supportive cells can damage nerve fibers and interfere with cognitive function.
paras.zh: 这项发表在《自然医学》上的研究挑战了人们长期以来认为这些细胞总是有益的观点。通过检查人类脑组织并在小鼠身上进行实验，研究人员发现证据表明这些正常支持细胞的问题会损害神经纤维并干扰认知功能。

paras.en: The discovery also points to a possible new approach for protecting the aging brain. Drugs that act on the biological pathway involved are already being used to treat other neurological conditions, raising hopes that existing treatments could eventually be adapted to combat age-related cognitive decline.
paras.zh: 这一发现还指出了一种可能的保护衰老大脑的新方法。作用于相关生物途径的药物已经被用于治疗其他神经系统疾病，这让人们希望现有的治疗方法最终能够适应与年龄相关的认知衰退。

paras.en: Scientists Discover Changes in the Aging Brain
paras.zh: 科学家发现衰老大脑的变化

paras.en: The study was led by researchers from the University of Edinburgh and the UK Dementia Research Institute, who investigated how changes in the brain relate to declining cognitive abilities later in life.
paras.zh: 这项研究由爱丁堡大学和英国痴呆症研究所的研究人员领导，他们研究了大脑的变化与晚年认知能力下降之间的关系。

paras.en: Their research focused on the Lothian Birth Cohort 1936, a group of people whose cognitive abilities have been tracked from childhood into old age. This unusually extensive record allowed scientists to investigate how thinking and memory changed over decades.
paras.zh: 他们的研究重点是 1936 年洛锡安出生队列，这群人的认知能力从童年到老年都被追踪。这种异常广泛的记录使科学家能够研究几十年来思维和记忆是如何变化的。

paras.en: Between ages 70 and 82, participants underwent assessments measuring memory, the speed at which they processed information, and their ability to understand spatial relationships.
paras.zh: 70 岁至 82 岁之间的参与者接受了评估，测量记忆力、处理信息的速度以及理解空间关系的能力。

paras.en: Of the 1,091 people enrolled in the cohort, 866 completed additional cognitive testing after age 70. Nearly everyone experienced at least some decline, but the rate varied considerably. These differences gave researchers an opportunity to investigate what might distinguish brains experiencing faster deterioration from those aging more gradually.
paras.zh: 在参与该队列的 1,091 人中，有 866 人在 70 岁后完成了额外的认知测试。几乎每个人都至少经历了一些下降，但速度差异很大。这些差异使研究人员有机会研究如何区分快速退化的大脑和缓慢老化的大脑。

paras.en: When scientists examined brain tissue collected after death from a subset of participants, they discovered a striking pattern. Individuals who had experienced greater cognitive decline tended to have fewer large nerve fibers, along with an abnormal buildup of unhealthy myelin.
paras.zh: 当科学家检查一部分参与者死后收集的脑组织时，他们发现了一个惊人的模式。认知能力下降较严重的人往往具有较少的大神经纤维，并且不健康的髓磷脂异常堆积。

paras.en: Myelin is the protective coating that surrounds nerve fibers, helping electrical signals travel efficiently through the brain. Although this insulation is essential for normal brain function, the findings suggest that excessive or abnormal myelin may become part of the problem.
paras.zh: 髓磷脂是围绕神经纤维的保护层，帮助电信号有效地通过大脑。尽管这种绝缘对于正常的大脑功能至关重要，但研究结果表明，过量或异常的髓磷脂可能成为问题的一部分。

paras.en: The changes were especially pronounced around the large nerve fibers that remained. Importantly, these abnormalities were associated with how quickly cognitive abilities declined, rather than how well someone performed on cognitive tests at a particular age.
paras.zh: 留下的大神经纤维周围的变化尤其明显。重要的是，这些异常与认知能力下降的速度有关，而不是与某人在特定年龄的认知测试中的表现有关。

paras.en: A Protective Brain Cell May Have a Hidden Weakness
paras.zh: 保护性脑细胞可能有一个隐藏的弱点

paras.en: To understand what might be causing these changes, the researchers turned their attention to oligodendrocytes, specialized brain cells responsible for producing and maintaining myelin.
paras.zh: 为了了解可能导致这些变化的原因，研究人员将注意力转向少突胶质细胞，这是一种负责产生和维持髓磷脂的特殊脑细胞。

paras.en: Oligodendrocytes have traditionally been regarded as beneficial because they help keep nerve fibers insulated and functioning properly. However, the new findings suggest that these cells can become dysfunctional during aging and may contribute to the very problems they normally help prevent.
The researchers discovered that people with more severe cognitive decline had lower levels of a protein called NRF2 inside their oligodendrocytes.

NRF2 plays an important protective role in cells by regulating hundreds of genes involved in defending against damage and maintaining normal cellular function. When its activity decreases, cells may become less capable of protecting themselves and performing their usual jobs.
paras.zh: NRF2 通过调节数百个参​​与防御损伤和维持正常细胞功能的基因，在细胞中发挥重要的保护作用。当其活性降低时，细胞保护自身和执行日常工作的能力可能会降低。

paras.en: To investigate whether this protein was directly involved in the brain changes, the team conducted experiments in mice.
paras.zh: 为了研究这种蛋白质是否直接参与大脑变化，研究小组在小鼠身上进行了实验。

paras.en: When researchers specifically reduced NRF2 in oligodendrocytes, the animals developed excessive myelin and lost large nerve fibers, closely resembling the abnormalities observed in human brain tissue. The mice also showed reduced improvements in cognitive performance as they aged.
paras.zh: 当研究人员专门减少少突胶质细胞中的 NRF2 时，动物会产生过多的髓磷脂并失去大的神经纤维，这与在人类脑组织中观察到的异常非常相似。 The mice also showed reduced improvements in cognitive performance as they aged.

paras.en: These experiments provided evidence that declining NRF2 activity can directly disrupt oligodendrocyte function, potentially triggering changes in myelin and nerve fibers that contribute to cognitive decline.
paras.zh: 这些实验提供的证据表明，NRF2 活性下降可以直接破坏少突胶质细胞功能，可能引发髓磷脂和神经纤维的变化，从而导致认知能力下降。

paras.en: Existing Drugs Could Offer a New Treatment Strategy
paras.zh: 现有药物可以提供新的治疗策略

paras.en: The findings may have important implications for developing treatments that help preserve cognitive abilities in older adults.
paras.zh: 这些发现可能对开发有助于保持老年人认知能力的治疗方法具有重要意义。

paras.en: One particularly promising aspect is that the NRF2 pathway is already a target of medications used for other conditions, including a drug prescribed to treat multiple sclerosis (MS).
paras.zh: 一个特别有希望的方面是，NRF2 通路已经成为用于其他疾病的药物的靶标，包括治疗多发性硬化症 (MS) 的药物。

paras.en: Previous studies have found that increasing NRF2 activity can improve cognitive function in people with MS. That raises the possibility that medications acting on the same pathway might eventually be repurposed to address oligodendrocyte dysfunction and age-related cognitive decline.
paras.zh: 先前的研究发现，增加 NRF2 活性可以改善多发性硬化症患者的认知功能。这就提出了一种可能性，即作用于同一途径的药物最终可能被重新用于解决少突胶质细胞功能障碍和与年龄相关的认知能力下降。

paras.en: Although further research is needed to determine whether such treatments would benefit older adults experiencing cognitive decline, the discovery identifies a potentially valuable therapeutic target.
paras.zh: 尽管还需要进一步的研究来确定这种治疗是否有益于认知能力下降的老年人，但这一发现确定了一个潜在有价值的治疗靶点。

paras.en: Veronique Miron, MRC Senior Non-Clinical Fellow and UK Dementia Research Institute Group Leader at the University of Edinburgh and St. Michael's Hospital, part of Unity Health Toronto, said:

"As the prevalence of cognitive decline is rising with an aging population and no current treatments exist, we are excited about this work as it points to a potential strategy for new therapeutic strategies to preserve cognitive ability in aging."
A New Understanding of Cognitive Decline
paras.zh: 对认知衰退的新认识

paras.en: Beyond its potential medical applications, the research changes how scientists understand the role of oligodendrocytes in the aging brain.
paras.zh: 除了潜在的医学应用之外，这项研究还改变了科学家理解少突胶质细胞在衰老大脑中的作用的方式。

paras.en: Rather than simply providing support for healthy nerve function throughout life, these cells appear capable of becoming dysfunctional and contributing to cognitive problems.
paras.zh: 这些细胞并不是简单地为整个生命过程中的健康神经功能提供支持，而是似乎能够变得功能失调并导致认知问题。

paras.en: Georgina Craig, the study's first author and a Postdoctoral Fellow at St Michael's Hospital in Toronto and the UK Dementia Research Institute, said:
paras.zh: 该研究的第一作者、多伦多圣迈克尔医院和英国痴呆症研究所的博士后研究员乔治娜·克雷格说：

paras.en: "This study has fundamentally shifted how we think about these brain cells in aging. We have always considered oligodendrocytes as purely beneficial, yet here we surprisingly find that they can become dysfunctional and contribute to cognitive impairment in aging."
The findings suggest that maintaining healthy oligodendrocyte function could become an important strategy for protecting memory and thinking abilities as people grow older.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，随着人们年龄的增长，保持健康的少突胶质细胞功能可能成为保护记忆和思维能力的重要策略。

paras.en: Published in Nature Medicine, the study was funded by the UKRI Medical Research Council (MRC) and the Canadian Institutes of Health Research (CIHR). The research also involved scientists from the University of Edinburgh's Lothian Birth Cohort studies and Northwestern University.
paras.zh: Published in Nature Medicine, the study was funded by the UKRI Medical Research Council (MRC) and the Canadian Institutes of Health Research (CIHR).这项研究还涉及爱丁堡大学洛锡安出生队列研究和西北大学的科学家。

articles.title: Scientists find 'gemstones' in atmosphere of bizarre, scorching-hot 'marshmallow' exoplanet
articles.author: Robert Lea

paras.en: Using data from the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), astronomers have unraveled some of the atmospheric secrets of a bizarre, blisteringly hot world that has the consistency of marshmallow.
paras.zh: 利用詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜 (JWST) 的数据，天文学家揭开了一个奇异、酷热、稠度如棉花糖的世界的一些大气秘密。

paras.en: The extrasolar planet, or exoplanet, under the watchful infrared eye of the JWST, is WASP-17b, located around 1,300 light-years away. The exoplanet has a mass around 0.8 times that of Jupiter, but it is around twice as wide as the solar system's largest planet, giving it a "super-puff" consistency comparable to the Earth-based treat. WASP-17 b is so close to its parent star that it completes an orbit in under four Earth days, with this proximity also making the temperature of this "hot Jupiter" skyrocket.
paras.zh: 在 JWST 红外观测仪的监视下，这颗系外行星是 WASP-17b，距离我们约 1,300 光年。这颗系外行星的质量约为木星的 0.8 倍，但其宽度约为太阳系最大行星的两倍，使其具有与地球上的行星相当的“超级蓬松”稠度。 WASP-17 b 距离其母星非常近，不到四个地球日就完成了一周的运行，这种接近也使得这颗“热木星”的温度飙升。

paras.en: Given the extreme conditions of this exoplanet, it is little wonder that its atmosphere is pretty unusual too. Using a new technique called transmission strings, a team of scientists mapped the contours of the atmosphere of WASP-17b. They found that the atmosphere is shaped like a ring with prominent "gems" rising from it.
paras.zh: 考虑到这颗系外行星的极端条件，它的大气层也很不寻常也就不足为奇了。一组科学家使用一种称为传输线的新技术绘制了 WASP-17b 大气层的轮廓图。他们发现大气层的形状像一个环，上面有突出的“宝石”。

paras.en: "Planets are temperamental, their atmospheres complex and chaotic," team member Hannah Wakeford of the University of Bristol said in a statement. "The fact that all of these numbers came together and showed us this very structured, dynamical picture of this giant world over 1,000 light-years away was just really exciting."
paras.zh: 布里斯托大学的团队成员汉娜·韦克福德在一份声明中说：“行星是喜怒无常的，它们的大气层复杂而混乱。” “事实上，所有这些数字结合在一起，向我们展示了这个 1000 光年之外的巨大世界的结构性、动态图景，真是令人兴奋。”

paras.en: Astronomers like WASP-17b so much they put a ring on it
paras.zh: 天文学家非常喜欢 WASP-17b，他们在它上面戴了一个环

paras.en: WASP-17b is so close to its parent star that it is tidally locked, meaning one side permanently faces the star; its dayside is constantly bombarded with stellar radiation. In contrast, the planet also has a cooler nightside, which faces out into space in perpetuity.
paras.zh: WASP-17b 距离其母星非常近，以至于它被潮汐锁定，这意味着一侧永远面向母星；它的向阳面不断受到恒星辐射的轰击。相比之下，这颗行星还有一个凉爽的夜晚，永远面向太空。

paras.en: By creating incredibly comprehensive 3D views of this exoplanet's atmosphere, researchers found that WASP-17b's atmosphere has a chemical composition and temperature that shift between dayside and nightside according to theory and modelling.
paras.zh: 通过创建这颗系外行星大气层的极其全面的 3D 视图，研究人员发现 WASP-17b 大气层的化学成分和温度根据理论和模型在白天和黑夜之间变化。

paras.en: This was possible because the transmission strings technique tracked WASP-17b as it crossed or transited in front of its star, capturing the composition of light around the edge of the planet's atmosphere, or limb, from different angles. This method trumps standard approaches because traditional modelling only maps light as an average across the entire limb.
paras.zh: 这是可能的，因为传输弦技术跟踪 WASP-17b 在其恒星前面穿过或凌日时的情况，从不同角度捕获行星大气层边缘或边缘周围的光的成分。这种方法胜过标准方法，因为传统建模仅将光线映射为整个肢体的平均值。

paras.en: "Rather than assuming your atmosphere is a circle with the same radius all the way around, our technique allows you to pull out different distances from the center to the edge of the planet," Lili Alderson, of Cornell University, said. "We're able to go around the edge.
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学的莉莉·奥尔德森说：“我们的技术不是假设大气层是一个四周半径相同的圆，而是可以拉出从地球中心到边缘的不同距离。” “我们能够绕过边缘。

paras.en: "So, we've gone from a ring to understanding where on the ring the gemstones are, so to speak."
paras.zh: “所以，可以这么说，我们已经从戒指转向了解宝石在戒指上的位置。”

paras.en: The modelling showed just such a "gem," that occurs where hot winds from the planet reach the equator and the nightside of WASP-17b, the atmosphere of the cooler side inflates.
paras.zh: 模型展示了这样一个“宝石”，它发生在来自行星的热风到达赤道和 WASP-17b 的夜间的地方，较冷一侧的大气层膨胀。

paras.en: "Theory predicts that the morning and the evening sides should have a strong temperature difference, and WASP-17b fits really nicely in that trend – pretty much bang-on what we thought it would be," Alderson said.
paras.zh: 奥尔德森说：“理论预测早上和晚上应该有很大的温差，而 WASP-17b 非常适合这种趋势——与我们的预期非常吻合。”

paras.en: The successful application of the transmission strings method is an exciting step forward in the modelling of the atmospheres of the over 6,000 worlds in NASA's exoplanet catalog.
paras.zh: 传输弦方法的成功应用是 NASA 系外行星目录中 6,000 多个世界的大气层建模中向前迈出的激动人心的一步。

paras.en: "This is proof of concept that planets are, in fact, 3D objects, and that, consistently, as they go around their star, what we predict should be happening is happening," Alderson concluded. "To move beyond computational exercises and see it for real is a different matter."
paras.zh: 奥尔德森总结道：“这证明了行星实际上是 3D 物体，并且当它们围绕恒星运行时，我们预测应该发生的事情始终如一地发生。” “超越计算练习并真正看到它是另一回事。”

paras.en: The team's research was published on Wednesday (Oct.14) in the journal Nature Astronomy.
paras.zh: 该团队的研究成果于周三（10 月 14 日）发表在《自然天文学》杂志上。

paras.en: Robert Lea is a science journalist in the U.K. whose articles have been published in Physics World, New Scientist, Astronomy Magazine, All About Space, Newsweek and ZME Science. He also writes about science communication for Elsevier and the European Journal of Physics. Rob holds a bachelor of science degree in physics and astronomy from the U.K.’s Open University. Follow him on Twitter @sciencef1rst.
paras.zh: 罗伯特·李 (Robert Lea) 是一位英国科学记者，其文章发表在《物理世界》、《新科学家》、《天文学杂志》、《All About Space》、《新闻周刊》和《ZME Science》上。他还为爱思唯尔和《欧洲物理学杂志》撰写有关科学传播的文章。 Rob 拥有英国开放大学物理和天文学理学学士学位。在 Twitter 上关注他@sciencef1rst。

articles.title: The Orionid meteor shower peaks next week! Here's what to expect
articles.author: Anthony Wood

paras.en: The Orionid meteor shower peaks overnight on Oct. 21-22, triggering a spectacular display of shooting stars as Earth plunges through the densest part of the debris trail shed by Halley's Comet. Here's what you need to know.
paras.zh: 猎户座流星雨于 10 月 21 日至 22 日夜间达到顶峰，当地球坠入哈雷彗星留下的碎片轨迹最密集的部分时，会引发壮观的流星表演。这是您需要了解的内容。

paras.en: When is the best time to see Orionid shooting stars?
paras.zh: 观赏猎户座流星雨的最佳时间是什么时候？

paras.en: Orionid meteors are best spotted between the hours of midnight and dawn on Oct. 22, when 10-20 shooting stars may be seen brightening the night sky each hour under ideal dark-sky.
paras.zh: 猎户座流星雨的最佳观测时间是 10 月 22 日的午夜和黎明，在理想的黑暗天空下，每小时可以看到 10-20 颗流星照亮夜空。

paras.en: The glare cast by the 74%-lit waxing gibbous moon will hide fainter shooting stars for much of the night. Thankfully, the lunar disk will set a few hours after midnight, leaving a window of beautifully dark sky before dawn in which to enjoy the full majesty of the annual meteor shower. Remember to use a trusted website like Time and Date to discover the exact moment of moonset for your location.
paras.zh: 74% 亮度的渐盈凸月发出的眩光将在夜晚的大部分时间里掩盖较暗的流星。值得庆幸的是，月盘将在午夜后几小时落下，在黎明前留下一扇美丽的黑暗天空之窗，让您可以欣赏一年一度流星雨的壮丽景色。请记住使用“时间和日期”等值得信赖的网站来查找您所在位置月落的确切时刻。

paras.en: Where should I look to see Orionid meteors?
paras.zh: 我应该去哪里观看猎户座流星雨？

paras.en: Orionid shooting stars will appear to originate from a patch of sky, or radiant, located close to the red giant star Betelgeuse in the constellation Orion, which glistens above the southeastern horizon for stargazers in the U.S. during the early hours of Oct. 22.
paras.zh: 猎户座流星雨似乎源自猎户座红巨星参宿四附近的一片天空或辐射点，10 月 22 日凌晨，猎户座红巨星在美国观星者的东南地平线上空闪闪发光。

paras.en: For the best views look 40-90 degrees away from the radiant, where the glowing trains left in the wake of the fast-moving meteors will be at their longest. Be sure to head away from artificial lights and allow 20-30 minutes for your eyes to fully adapt to the dark for the best
paras.zh: 为了获得最佳景观，请在远离辐射点 40-90 度的位置观看，此时快速移动的流星留下的发光列车将处于最长的位置。确保远离人造光，并留出 20-30 分钟的时间让您的眼睛完全适应黑暗，以获得最佳效果

paras.en: The Orionid meteor shower is active each year as Earth passes through the stream of debris left behind by Comet 1P/Halley, which was observed by a fleet of spacecraft when it last visited the inner solar system in 1986.
paras.zh: 猎户座流星雨每年都会在地球穿过 1P/哈雷彗星留下的碎片流时活跃起来，1986 年哈雷彗星最后一次造访内太阳系时，一组航天器曾观测到猎户座流星雨。

paras.en: Shooting stars become visible when particles of the ancient comet collide with our planet's atmosphere at 147,600 miles per hour (237,539 kilometers per hour), vaporizing in a spectacular display of natural fireworks.
paras.zh: 当这颗古老彗星的粒子以每小时 147,600 英里（每小时 237,539 公里）的速度与地球大气层碰撞时，流星就变得可见，并在壮观的自然烟花表演中蒸发。

paras.en: Hoping to catch a shooting star for yourself? Then be sure to read our guide to photographing meteor showers, along with our picks of the best cameras and lenses for astrophotography.
Editor's Note: If you would like to share your Orionid photos with Space.com's readers, then please send your photo(s), comments, and your name and location to spacephotos@space.com.
paras.zh: 编者注：如果您想与 Space.com 的读者分享您的猎户座流星雨照片，请将您的照片、评论以及您的姓名和位置发送至 spacephotos@space.com。

paras.en: Anthony Wood joined Space.com in April 2025 after contributing articles to outlets including IGN, New Atlas and Gizmodo. He has a passion for the night sky, science, Hideo Kojima, and human space exploration, and can’t wait for the day when astronauts once again set foot on the moon.
paras.zh: 安东尼·伍德 (Anthony Wood) 向 IGN、New Atlas 和 Gizmodo 等媒体投稿后于 2025 年 4 月加入 Space.com。他热爱夜空、科学、小岛秀夫和人类太空探索，迫不及待地等待宇航员再次踏上月球的那一天。

articles.title: 'Lanterns' shocking finale left us with a lot of unanswered questions for a potential season 2
articles.author: Jeff Spry

paras.en: HBO and HBO Max's "Lanterns" served up its big cliffhanger finale on Oct. 4, 2026, and we’ve been slowly digesting thoughts on what the creative direction and ultimate legacy of this debut season were.
paras.zh: HBO 和 HBO Max 的《灯笼》于 2026 年 10 月 4 日迎来了扣人心弦的大结局，我们一直在慢慢消化对这一首季的创意方向和最终遗产的思考。

paras.en: While by no means a perfect experiment in trying to shake up the aging superhero genre, there are enough worthy elements to consider this sci-fi mystery show an evolutionary step towards the next generation of comic-based storytelling.
paras.zh: 虽然这绝不是一个试图撼动老化超级英雄类型的完美实验，但有足够的有价值的元素可以认为这部科幻悬疑片向下一代漫画故事讲述迈出了进化的一步。

paras.en: After the emerald-tinted dust has settled, there are many lingering questions about where this acclaimed series from creators Chris Mundy, Damon Lindelof, and Tom King might be headed and where the twists and turns might lead for a sophomore season should it be greenlit (get it?) for a triumphant return.
paras.zh: 翠绿的尘埃落定后，人们对这部由克里斯·芒迪、达蒙·林德洛夫和汤姆·金创作的广受好评的剧集可能会走向何方以及如果它获得批准（明白吗？）凯旋归来的话，第二季的曲折可能会导致什么方向有许多挥之不去的疑问。

paras.en: One of "Lanterns"' standout achievements is revealing the true costs of superheroism by deconstructing its DNA and examining the ugly guts of it all.
paras.zh: 《灯笼》的杰出成就之一是通过解构超级英雄主义的 DNA 并审视其丑陋的本质，揭示超级英雄主义的真正代价。

paras.en: It dives into the fear, trauma, and seduction that drive humans to take up the serious business of protecting the universe and doling out justice against both Earth-bound evil and intergalactic threats. "Lanterns" also explores mental health issues and PTSD that are the inevitable byproducts of a life of unimaginable violence. The compelling series achieves a provocative dissection of it all with rare confidence without the overindulgence of distracting CGI tossed in for sheer spectacle.
paras.zh: 它深入探讨了恐惧、创伤和诱惑，这些驱使人类承担起保护宇宙的严肃任务，并针对地球上的邪恶和星际威胁伸张正义。 《灯笼》还探讨了心理健康问题和创伤后应激障碍（PTSD），这些问题是难以想象的暴力生活不可避免的副产品。这部引人入胜的剧集以罕见的自信对这一切进行了挑衅性的剖析，没有为了纯粹的奇观而过度沉迷于分散注意力的电脑图像。

paras.en: It might not have been exactly the Green Lantern TV series fans wanted, but it was the show we got, and kinda the show we needed. Sure, for a series about a noble order of intergalactic space cops, we were treated to very little cosmic action, and instead we're given a grounded slow-burn police procedural à la "True Detective."
paras.zh: 这可能不是绿灯侠电视剧粉丝想要的，但这是我们得到的节目，也是我们需要的节目。当然，对于一部关于星际太空警察的崇高秩序的系列剧，我们几乎没有看到宇宙行动，相反，我们得到了一个脚踏实地的缓慢燃烧的警察程序，就像《真探》一样。

paras.en: As I said before, it's not perfect, but we shouldn’t dismiss "Lanterns" for its mild shortcomings when it gets so much right. We're willing a second season into existence, and with an average of 20 million global viewers and solid reviews, HBO/HBO Max would be very wise to bring it back.
paras.zh: 正如我之前所说，它并不完美，但当它做得如此正确时，我们不应该因为它的轻微缺点而忽视它。我们愿意制作第二季，平均拥有 2000 万全球观众和好评，HBO/HBO Max 将其回归是非常明智的选择。

paras.en: Whether a second season shifts into the heavens to rocket off on an outer space trajectory for a follow-up season is yet to be seen. For now, though, the Lanterns season one finale has left us with plenty of questions to ponder.
paras.zh: 第二季是否会转移到天空并在后续季节的外太空轨道上火箭升空还有待观察。不过，就目前而言，《灯笼》第一季的结局给我们留下了很多值得思考的问题。

paras.en: "Lanterns"' season finale revealed that Kerry, in an unhinged moment of maternal panic trying to protect her mutant son, Noah, had put a bullet in Hal's head. RIP to the original Green Lantern... or is it?
paras.zh: 《灯笼》季终集透露，凯瑞在母亲恐慌中试图保护她的变异儿子诺亚，在精神错乱的时刻，向哈尔的头部开了一枪。愿原作《绿灯侠》安息……是吗？

paras.en: Kyle Chandler was a fantastic choice to play Hal Jordan, and he brought a charismatic gravitas and twisted sense of humor to the storied comic character. His sudden death in Rushville, frozen in the bleachers of the high school football stadium, certainly looked final, but this is the wild topsy-turvy universe of superheroes, so anything is possible.
paras.zh: 凯尔·钱德勒是扮演哈尔·乔丹的绝佳选择，他为这个传奇的喜剧角色带来了超凡的魅力和扭曲的幽默感。他在拉什维尔的突然死亡，冰冻在高中足球场的看台上，看起来确实是最后的结局，但这是超级英雄的疯狂宇宙，所以一切皆有可能。

paras.en: And don’t forget that the newly-freed Thaal Sinestro (Ulrich Thomsen) told the AI “Halogram” and Aaron Pierre’s John Stewart on Antaan's dead planet that the magical green ring could be used to restore Hal’s life. But Sinestro is a sly, slippery foe and is never to be trusted!
paras.zh: 不要忘记，刚刚获释的塔尔·辛斯特罗（乌尔里奇·汤姆森饰）在安塔安死去的星球上告诉人工智能“光环图”和亚伦·皮埃尔饰演的约翰·斯图尔特，神奇的绿环可以用来恢复哈尔的生命。但辛斯特罗是一个狡猾、狡猾的敌人，永远不值得信任！

paras.en: Online speculation has proposed that Hal Jordan might be revived and enter the series as Parallax, the living embodiment of fear, but that’s not likely according to the series creators. What’s more probable is that we either see Chandler's Hal Jordan revived, or he'll just turn up in occasional flashbacks or Halogram pop-in scenes.
paras.zh: 网上猜测哈尔·乔丹可能会复活并以视差（视差）的身份进入该系列，视差是恐惧的活生生的化身，但根据该系列创作者的说法，这不太可能。更有可能的是，我们要么看到钱德勒饰演的哈尔·乔丹复活，要么他只会出现在偶尔的闪回或全息图弹出场景中。

paras.en: With his unsanctioned lantern battery now in hand to power his ring, Stewart has become an independent contractor protecting Earth for Guy Gardner’s (Nathan Fillion) Sector 2814.
paras.zh: 斯图尔特现在拥有未经批准的灯笼电池来为他的戒指供电，他已成为盖伊·加德纳（内森·菲利安饰）2814区保护地球的独立承包商。

paras.en: Fortified with the Sinestro-forged yellow charging unit deemed illegal by the Guardians and the broader members of the Green Lantern Corps., this unattached Lantern is now free to make sure Noah doesn’t turn to the dark side and lean into his evil Manhunter programming.
paras.zh: 凭借被守护者和绿灯军团更广泛的成员视为非法的塞尼斯特罗锻造的黄色冲锋装置，这个独立的灯笼现在可以自由地确保诺亚不会转向黑暗面并倾向于他邪恶的猎人编程。

paras.en: Will Stewart be seduced into the path of corruption by using Sinestro’s emotionally tainted battery, or steel himself against ill influences and continue to blaze his own trail as Earth's sole protector for the time being?
paras.zh: 斯图尔特会因为使用辛斯特罗的情感污染电池而被引诱走上腐败之路，还是会坚强地抵御不良影响并继续作为地球暂时的唯一保护者开辟自己的道路？

paras.en: As a gold-toothed Gardner tells Stewart, "When I take this bull**** up back to Oa, they’re gonna send an army to put you down." This sounds like the perfect setup for an eventful "Lanterns" season 2 where the Lantern Corps come to take Jordan in, dead or alive. It’ll be interesting to see which of the infamous space cops they eventually send. This ain't over!
paras.zh: 正如一位金牙加德纳告诉斯图尔特的那样，“当我把这头公牛带回欧州时，他们会派出一支军队来镇压你。”这听起来像是一个多事之秋的“灯笼”第二季的完美设置，灯笼军团来抓捕乔丹，无论是死是活。看看他们最终派出哪些臭名昭著的太空警察将会很有趣。这还没有结束！

paras.en: Sheriff Kerry Kane (Kelly Macdonald) and the dorky Billy Macon’s (Jason Ritter) immaculately conceived son, Noah, is outed as a Human-Manhunter hybrid that came into being after Kerry’s initial encounter with Manhunter Zoe years ago.
paras.zh: 警长克里·凯恩（凯利·麦克唐纳饰）和傻乎乎的比利·梅肯（杰森·里特饰）完美怀上的儿子诺亚被揭露为人类与猎人的混血儿，他是在克里多年前与猎人佐伊初次相遇后诞生的。

paras.en: He might be one helluva gunslinging high school quarterback now, but that pales in comparison to what he could become using his frightful shapeshifting Manhunter genes inherited from his grandmother.
paras.zh: 他现在可能是一名出色的枪手高中四分卫，但这与他利用从他祖母那里继承的可怕的变形猎人基因所可能成为的东西相比显得相形见绌。

paras.en: With his new Nebraska collegiate ball cap and now headed off to university, the sleeper agent has some vital decisions to make way beyond declaring a major. His desire will be to wipe out the Green Lanterns and the Guardians, but Earthly domination might come first unless he pledges to subdue his instincts and lead a normal life. And is Noah really the last Manhunter, or are there legions more ready to activate?
paras.zh: 戴上新的内布拉斯加州大学球帽，现在即将进入大学，这位潜伏的经纪人除了宣布专业之外，还有一些重要的决定要做。他的愿望是消灭绿灯侠和守护者，但除非他发誓克制自己的本能并过上正常的生活，否则地球的统治可能是第一位的。诺亚真的是最后一个猎人，还是有更多的军团准备激活？

paras.en: Spazkaban (or Space Azkaban), the notorious cosmic penitentiary controlled by the Guardians, lost one of its most lethal inhabitants in the crimson-skinned Sinestro when Noah (Shea Pritchard), the nascent Manhunter, broke him out of jail to craft him a yellow fear-based lantern.
paras.zh: 斯帕兹卡班（或太空阿兹卡班）是由守护者控制的臭名昭著的宇宙监狱，当初生的猎人诺亚（谢伊·普里查德饰）将他从监狱中救出来并为他制作了一盏基于恐惧的黄色灯笼时，他在深红色皮肤的塞尼斯特罗中失去了一名最致命的居民。

paras.en: This persuasive villain was last seen wrapped in chains in the season finale, "Dirt and Stars," being dunked in the waters of madness by Stewart on the poison planet after a portal hop, before trying to coerce Halogram to deliver the prized ring for Jordan's resurrection.
paras.zh: 这个有说服力的恶棍最后一次出现是在季终集《尘土与星星》中，他被锁链缠住，在一次传送门跳跃后，被斯图尔特在有毒星球上的疯狂水中浸泡，然后试图强迫哈拉图姆为乔丹的复活提供珍贵的戒指。

paras.en: Avid comic fans know Sinestro once commanded his own intergalactic corp that fed upon the addictive yellow glare of fear instead of the emerald light’s will-imposed power.
paras.zh: 狂热的漫画迷都知道，塞尼斯特罗曾经指挥过自己的星际军团，这支军团以令人上瘾的黄色眩光恐惧为食，而不是翡翠光芒的意志强加的力量。

paras.en: Will he unite with Noah to take down the manipulative Guardians of the Universe and their legion of space-bound enforcers, the Green Lanterns? Will Noah break bad or go good? And is it possible for Sinestro to forge another yellow lantern and a custom companion ring to escape captivity? As Sinestro explains, "If harnessed correctly, fear can be the most powerful force in the universe."
paras.zh: 他会与诺亚联合起来，打倒那些善于操纵的宇宙守护者和他们的太空执法者军团——绿灯侠吗？诺亚会变坏还是变好？塞尼斯特罗是否有可能伪造另一个黄色灯笼和定制的伴侣戒指来逃脱囚禁？正如塞尼斯特罗解释的那样，“如果运用得当，恐惧可以成为宇宙中最强大的力量。”

paras.en: Shards of "Lanterns" will invariably bleed over into James Gunn's "Superman" sequel, "Man of Tomorrow," which soars to theaters on July 9, 2027, so there’s still a lot of life left in DC Studios' DCU.
paras.zh: 《灯笼》的碎片总是会融入到詹姆斯·冈恩的《超人》续集《明日之人》中，该片将于 2027 年 7 月 9 日上映，因此 DC 影业的 DCU 仍然充满活力。

paras.en: All 8 episodes of "Lanterns" season 1 are available on HBO and HBO Max.
paras.zh: 《灯笼》第一季的全部 8 集均可在 HBO 和 HBO Max 上观看。

paras.en: Jeff Spry is an award-winning screenwriter and veteran freelance journalist covering TV, movies, video games, books, and comics. His work has appeared at SYFY Wire, Inverse, Collider, Bleeding Cool and elsewhere. Jeff lives in beautiful Bend, Oregon amid the ponderosa pines, classic muscle cars, a crypt of collector horror comics, and two loyal English Setters.
paras.zh: 杰夫·斯普里 (Jeff Spry) 是一位屡获殊荣的编剧和资深自由记者，报道电视、电影、视频游戏、书籍和漫画。他的作品曾出现在 SYFY Wire、Inverse、Collider、Bleeding Cool 等网站上。杰夫住在俄勒冈州美丽的本德，周围有黄松、经典肌肉车、收藏恐怖漫画的地窖和两只忠诚的英国塞特犬。

paras.zh: 评论前您必须确认您的公开显示名称

articles.title: Resource competition intensifies with surge in megaconstellations
articles.author: Hope Hodge Seck

paras.en: Amazon wants more than 5,000 satellites in orbit. Blue Origin has proposed another 5,400. Chinese companies have filed plans encompassing vastly more. Elon Musk has talked about a constellation numbering 1 million.
paras.zh: 亚马逊希望在轨卫星数量超过 5,000 颗。 Blue Origin 还提出了另外 5,400 个。中国公司已经提交了包含更多内容的计划。埃隆·马斯克曾谈到过一个数量为 100 万的星座。

paras.en: There is one issue: building all of them.
paras.zh: 有一个问题：建造所有这些。

paras.en: The unprecedented rush to put satellites into low Earth orbit is colliding with shortages of specialized components and materials, suppliers struggling to keep up and competition from the booming artificial intelligence industry. The squeeze is forcing satellite companies to rethink designs, accept delays and confront a more fundamental question about the timelines for what’s possible.
paras.zh: 将卫星送入近地轨道的空前热潮正与专业部件和材料的短缺、供应商的疲软以及蓬勃发展的人工智能行业的竞争相冲突。这种挤压迫使卫星公司重新考虑设计，接受延误，并面对一个更根本的问题，即可能发生的事情的时间表。

paras.en: Competition for scarce resources and supplies amid surging demand is forcing tradeoffs in industry that threaten to delay launches and may push companies out of the market or trigger greater consolidation.
paras.zh: 在需求激增的情况下，对稀缺资源和供应的竞争正在迫使行业进行权衡，这可能会推迟发布，并可能将公司赶出市场或引发更大的整合。

paras.en: “Companies right now are just looking at where they might be able to take additional risk,” said Steve Jordan Tomaszewski, vice president of space systems for the Aerospace Industries Association. He participated in a supply chain analysis with audit firm PricewaterhouseCoopers earlier this year that involved talking to dozens of industry representatives.
paras.zh: 航空航天工业协会太空系统副总裁史蒂夫·乔丹·托马泽斯基 (Steve Jordan Tomaszewski) 表示：“公司现在只是在考虑在哪些方面可以承担额外的风险。”今年早些时候，他参加了审计公司普华永道的供应链分析，其中涉及与数十名行业代表的交谈。

paras.en: Tomaszewski said supply chain challenges have companies looking for “where they can maybe downgrade something to not using a space-qualified component … Maybe they’re okay waiting a year for a certain type of valve because they know that’s going to be something they really have to deliver on.”
paras.zh: Tomaszewski 表示，供应链挑战让公司寻找“他们可以将某些产品降级到不使用符合太空要求的组件……也许他们可以为某种类型的阀门等待一年，因为他们知道这将是他们真正必须交付的东西。”

paras.en: The 54-page analysis isolated nine critical components contributing to supply chain bottlenecks due to an inability to keep up with demand, ranging from valves and actuators to switchgears and transformers. The report incorporated insights from about 30 professionals representing various parts of the satellite supply chain.
paras.zh: 这份长达 54 页的分析列出了由于无法满足需求而导致供应链瓶颈的九个关键组件，从阀门和执行器到开关设备和变压器。该报告融合了代表卫星供应链各个部分的约 30 名专业人士的见解。

paras.en: “We hear from companies that because demand is so high and capacity is not keeping up with demand,” Tomaszewski said. “That’s what’s forcing them to really make some of those hard decisions.”
paras.zh: “我们从公司那里得知，由于需求如此之高，而产能却跟不上需求，”托马泽夫斯基说。 “这就是迫使他们真正做出一些艰难决定的原因。”

paras.en: According to some estimates, the next few years could mean the nearly 19,000 satellites now in LEO joined by 70,000 more. And while analysts who spoke with SpaceNews were, across the board, unwilling to speak to companies’ plans and challenges on the record, they agreed that the coming demand signal will only exacerbate already-felt bottlenecks around limited and necessary resources.
paras.zh: 根据一些估计，未来几年可能意味着近 19,000 颗卫星目前位于近地轨道上，届时将增加 70,000 颗。尽管接受《SpaceNews》采访的分析师普遍不愿公开谈论公司的计划和挑战，但他们一致认为，即将到来的需求信号只会加剧有限和必要资源方面已经存在的瓶颈。

paras.en: As space companies face a ramp-up in competition from Earth-based data centers for the minerals and materials they need to launch megaconstellations, experts say something’s got to give, in the form of delays, industry consolidation, material substitutions or favorable new policies. And, amid increasing global instability, certain industry shocks could be sudden and severe.
paras.zh: 由于航天公司面临着来自地球数据中心对发射巨型星座所需的矿物和材料的激烈竞争，专家表示，必须采取一些措施，例如延迟、行业整合、材料替代或有利的新政策。而且，在全球不稳定因素日益增加的情况下，某些行业冲击可能是突然且严重的。

paras.en: One bottleneck stems from access to the rare earth minerals that are crucial for electronic components.
paras.zh: 一个瓶颈源于对电子元件至关重要的稀土矿物的获取。

paras.en: Carla Filotico, partner and managing director at the European consulting firm Novaspace, told SpaceNews she’s particularly concerned about gallium nitride (GaN) and germanium, two minerals used to build high-efficiency solar cells. For common satellite materials like aluminum, the possibility of running out isn’t much of a concern, she said.
paras.zh: 欧洲咨询公司 Novaspace 的合伙人兼董事总经理 Carla Filotico 告诉 SpaceNews，她特别担心氮化镓 (GaN) 和锗，这两种用于制造高效太阳能电池的矿物。她说，对于铝等常见卫星材料来说，用完的可能性并不大。

paras.en: “If we assume an average of 500 kilos of mass per satellite, and we make a pure calculation of the amount of aluminum necessary, we can say that, from the primary aluminum production that is currently quite large globally, this space sector is still a niche,” Filotico said.
paras.zh: 菲洛蒂科说：“如果我们假设每颗卫星的平均质量为 500 公斤，并纯粹计算所需的铝量，我们可以说，从目前全球相当大的原铝产量来看，这个航天领域仍然是一个利基市场。”

paras.en: Space applications make up a few percent of the market demand for GaN, on the other hand, and China’s chokehold on production, at around 98%, leaves U.S. and European companies vulnerable, she said. China is also a dominant producer of germanium, for which space applications make up an even larger market share.
paras.zh: 她表示，另一方面，太空应用仅占 GaN 市场需求的几个百分点，而中国对 GaN 产量的控制（约 98%）使美国和欧洲公司处于弱势。中国也是锗的主要生产国，其空间应用占据了更大的市场份额。

paras.en: She added that any restrictions on gallium export could cause a shortage for the space sector that could hit at any time.
paras.zh: 她补充说，对镓出口的任何限制都可能导致航天领域随时可能出现短缺。

paras.en: Even aluminum has become more scarce and costly amid shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz caused by the U.S.-Iran conflict.
paras.zh: 由于美伊冲突导致霍尔木兹海峡航运中断，就连铝也变得更加稀缺和昂贵。

paras.en: “Supply chain resilience has been a topic that has been very popular since COVID, but it’s just accelerated with more and more of these conflicts and disruptions,” said Doug Anderson, a partner at PwC’s Operations and Supply Chain Services practice who collaborated on the joint AIA report on space supply chain bottlenecks, released in March.
paras.zh: 普华永道运营和供应链服务业务合伙人道格·安德森 (Doug Anderson) 表示：“自新冠肺炎疫情以来，供应链弹性一直是一个非常热门的话题，但随着越来越多的冲突和干扰，供应链的弹性正在加速。”他参与撰写了 3 月份发布的美国建筑师协会关于太空供应链瓶颈的联合报告。

paras.en: “The Strait of Hormuz has impacted aluminum, has impacted helium. These are things that are very important for the space supply chain,” he said.
paras.zh: “霍尔木兹海峡影响了铝，也影响了氦。这些对于太空供应链来说非常重要，”他说。

paras.en: It’s a problem with a dangling threat but no clear solution, although the last year has seen efforts to establish new mineral supply pipelines, such as a May 2025 agreement between defense prime RTX and Emirates Global Aluminum to start up gallium production in Abu Dhabi. Filotico said the worst of the resource squeeze is likely to be felt in the next five years, with the planned peak of the new constellation launch wave set to hit by 2030.
paras.zh: 这是一个悬而未决的问题，但没有明确的解决方案，尽管去年人们努力建立新的矿产供应管道，例如国防总理 RTX 与阿联酋全球铝业公司于 2025 年 5 月达成协议，在阿布扎比启动镓生产。 Filotico表示，未来五年可能会感受到最严重的资源紧张，计划中的新星座发射浪潮将在2030年达到峰值。

paras.en: A trade disruption or geopolitical crisis that disrupts access to GaN and germanium “could certainly cause space sector shortage,” Filotico said.
paras.zh: 菲洛蒂科表示，贸易中断或地缘政治危机会扰乱获取 GaN 和锗的渠道，“肯定会导致航天部门短缺”。

paras.en: And megaconstellations, due to the realities of scaling and maintenance, exacerbate the hazard of a sudden disruption to mineral supply. At one to two solar arrays per satellite, a single megaconstellation can easily require 10,000-20,000 solar panels.
paras.zh: 而巨型星座，由于规模和维护的现实，加剧了矿产供应突然中断的危险。每颗卫星配备一到两个太阳能电池阵列，单个巨型星座很容易需要 10,000-20,000 个太阳能电池板。

paras.en: “We are talking about thousands of satellites per company per year at least, because you need to replenish the satellites every four or five years, depending on the orbital height,” Filotico said.
paras.zh: “我们谈论的是每家公司每年至少有数千颗卫星，因为你需要每四到五年补充一次卫星，具体取决于轨道高度，”菲洛蒂科说。

paras.en: The PwC-AIA analysis earlier this year revealed, among other things, that parts shortages are due not only to an inability to move faster and produce more, but also an unwillingness to do so.
paras.zh: 普华永道-友邦保险今年早些时候的分析显示，零部件短缺不仅是因为无法更快地行动和生产更多，而且还因为不愿意这样做。

paras.en: The report described suppliers who were passing up changes to bid on space work, “citing high complexity requirements and low return on effort.” It described one case specifically in which a legacy supplier opted not to rebid on making composite overwrapped pressure vessels, needed to store high pressure gases, because the work would take about one-third of all the available engineering time while only generating “low single-digit revenue.”
paras.zh: 该报告描述了那些放弃太空工作投标变更的供应商，“理由是复杂性要求高，工作回报率低”。它特别描述了一个案例，其中一家传统供应商选择不再重新投标制造需要储存高压气体的复合材料包裹压力容器，因为这项工作将占用所有可用工程时间的大约三分之一，同时只能产生“低个位数的收入”。

paras.en: At the Air Force Association’s Air Space & Cyber conference in September, Gurpartap “GP” Sandhoo, director of the Space Development Agency, said his organization continues to face supply-chain throughput and quality problems as it builds out its missile-tracking and data-transport constellations.
paras.zh: 在 9 月份的空军协会航空航天与网络会议上，太空发展局局长 Gurpartap“GP”Sandhoo 表示，他的组织在建设导弹跟踪和数据传输星座时继续面临供应链吞吐量和质量问题。

paras.en: “We have had a demand signal, but the quality control and being able to produce things at scale has been a challenge,” Sandhoo said.
paras.zh: “我们已经收到了需求信号，但质量控制和大规模生产一直是一个挑战，”桑德胡说。

paras.en: He pointed to optical communications hardware and focal-plane arrays as areas where suppliers have struggled with throughput, as well as the difficulty of manufacturing hardware that can withstand launch.
paras.zh: 他指出，光通信硬件和焦平面阵列是供应商在吞吐量方面苦苦挣扎的领域，以及制造能够承受发射的硬件的难度。

paras.en: Compounding the challenges, Tomaszewski said, are a surfeit of parts pipelines with just one or two suppliers, leading to single points of failure, and new customer competition in the form of AI data centers.
paras.zh: Tomaszewski 表示，只有一两个供应商的零件管道过多，导致单点故障以及人工智能数据中心形式的新客户竞争，这使得挑战更加复杂。

paras.en: Some suppliers are approaching changing buying patterns by designing parts that can scale to perform in both critical and risk-tolerant mission scenarios, Ken Stoler, a space business development lead for Arrow said on SpaceNews’ Space Minds podcast. He argued that a strong supply chain must be resilient and diverse.
paras.zh: Arrow 太空业务开发主管肯·斯托勒 (Ken Stoler) 在 SpaceNews 的 Space Minds 播客中表示，一些供应商正在通过设计可扩展以在关键和风险承受任务场景中执行的零件来改变购买模式。他认为，强大的供应链必须具有弹性和多样性。

paras.en: The demand for data centers has notably increased even in the months since the supply chain report was released, he said, and the builders of those centers may represent a more attractive and profitable customer for suppliers of critical components than satellite constellation-makers. With switchgears and transformers specifically, the report found AI companies were “gobbling these things up at scale” and creating years-long parts backlogs.
paras.zh: 他表示，即使在供应链报告发布后的几个月内，对数据中心的需求也显着增加，对于关键部件供应商来说，这些数据中心的建设者可能比卫星星座制造商更具吸引力和利润。报告发现，特别是开关设备和变压器，人工智能公司正在“大规模吞噬这些东西”，并造成长达数年的零件积压。

paras.en: “For a space company to come in and say, ‘Hey, we want to buy 10 of these for a new factory’ — compare that to … a big artificial intelligence company or data center company buying 10,000 of these things,” Tomaszewski said.
paras.zh: “对于一家航天公司来说，‘嘿，我们想为新工厂购买 10 个这样的东西’——与……一家大型人工智能公司或数据中心公司购买 10,000 个这样的东西相比，”Tomaszewski 说。

paras.en: “The scale of it, even with the surge in space, isn’t big enough to kind of change the trajectory of where those electrical boxes are going.”
paras.zh: “即使空间激增，它的规模也不足以改变这些配电箱的运行轨迹。”

paras.en: A challenge to broader efforts to ensure space companies have what they need to execute on their launch plans is a consistent and continual way to measure available resources, he said. There’s no guarantee, he added, that the nine critical components highlighted in March would still be at the top of the list today, and no simple way to find out.
paras.zh: 他表示，确保航天公司拥有执行发射计划所需资源的更广泛努力所面临的挑战是衡量可用资源的一致且持续的方法。他补充说，不能保证 3 月份强调的九个关键组成部分今天仍然位于列表的首位，而且没有简单的方法可以找出答案。

paras.en: “It’s been the problem with space that there hasn’t been kind of consistent awareness of where those issues are across programs, across you know national security space, civil space and commercial space,” Tomaszewski said.
paras.zh: 托马谢夫斯基说：“太空问题一直存在，人们对这些问题在各个项目、国家安全太空、民用太空和商业太空中的具体位置缺乏一致的认识。”

paras.en: That kind of data could also make it easier to enact policy interventions. For example, Tomaszewski proposes a “skip the line” authority that would allow the space industrial base to get in front of data centers and other competitors for resources.
paras.zh: 此类数据还可以使政策干预措施的实施变得更加容易。例如，托马斯泽夫斯基提出了一种“免排队”权限，允许航天工业基地领先于数据中心和其他竞争对手获取资源。

paras.en: “If we want to deliver on all these great capabilities from space and explore the solar system and beat China, you know, back to the moon, we might need to make sure that space is prioritized amongst all the other national priorities that we have,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“如果我们想从太空发挥所有这些强大的能力，探索太阳系并击败中国，重返月球，我们可能需要确保太空在我们所有其他国家优先事项中占据优先地位。”

paras.en: Tomaszewski said he was encouraged by steps from the federal Office of Space Commerce to allow government and industry players to strategize over supply chain issues and discuss possible regulatory moves that could help.
paras.zh: 托马斯泽夫斯基表示，联邦太空商务办公室采取的措施让他感到鼓舞，这些措施允许政府和行业参与者就供应链问题制定战略，并讨论可能有帮助的监管举措。

paras.en: “One big thing I think really still needs to get figured out is where the belly button is for fixing supply chain issues, especially at different government agencies,” he said. “Supply chain is a challenge because it is everybody’s problem, but it’s also nobody’s problem.”
paras.zh: “我认为真正需要弄清楚的一件大事是解决供应链问题的肚脐在哪里，特别是在不同的政府机构，”他说。 “供应链是一个挑战，因为它是每个人的问题，但也不是任何人的问题。”

paras.en: Another unspoken reality, according to multiple experts, is that some megaconstellation launch plans simply won’t come to fruition, at least not as originally envisioned. Space-watchers expect to see an increase in vertical integration, in which larger companies fold parts of their supply chain into themselves. But they also anticipate industry consolidation, along with some companies dropping out of the market as they find themselves unable to achieve their objectives on their own.
paras.zh: 多位专家表示，另一个不言而喻的现实是，一些巨型星座发射计划根本不会实现，至少不会像最初设想的那样。太空观察家期望看到垂直整合的增加，即大公司将部分供应链纳入自身。但他们也预计行业整合，一些公司会因为发现自己无法实现自己的目标而退出市场。

paras.en: “Ten, 12 years ago, when the applications were submitted with the FCC for constellations of low Earth orbit satellites, no one expected all of them to move forward, and some of them just decided not to move forward with their plans,” said Doug Stroup, president of the Satellite Industry Association. “I suspect that we’ll see some of the same thing happening with respect to the recent round of applications that have been filed.”
paras.zh: 卫星工业协会主席道格·斯特鲁普 (Doug Stroup) 表示：“10 年、12 年前，当向 FCC 提交近地轨道卫星星座申请时，没有人期望所有这些卫星都会向前推进，其中一些只是决定不再推进他们的计划。” “我怀疑我们会在最近一轮提交的申请中看到一些同样的事情发生。”

paras.en: This article first appeared in the October 2026 issue of SpaceNews Magazine.
paras.zh: 本文首次发表于 2026 年 10 月号《太空新闻》杂志。

paras.en: EDITOR’S NOTE: An earlier version of this story misspelled Steve Jordan Tomaszewski. It has been updated.
paras.zh: 编者注：这个故事的早期版本拼写错误了 Steve Jordan Tomaszewski。它已经更新了。

articles.title: Announcing the finalists for the 2026 SpaceNews Icon Awards
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: The SpaceNews Icon Awards celebrate the year’s most iconic achievements in shaping the future of the space industry. Today, we’re proud to announce the shortlist for 2026 — a selection of individuals, organizations, and missions that exemplify excellence in innovation, exploration and sustainability.
paras.zh: 太空新闻偶像奖旨在表彰今年在塑造航天工业未来方面最具标志性的成就。今天，我们很自豪地宣布 2026 年入围名单，其中包括在创新、探索和可持续发展方面表现卓越的个人、组织和使命。

paras.en: This year’s honorees represent a range of accomplishments — from returning astronauts to the vicinity of the moon and expanding the capacity to run AI on orbit to accelerating the realization of on-orbit servicing and advancing scale through partnerships and acquisitions. These finalists reflect the creativity and ambition propelling today’s growth.
paras.zh: 今年的获奖者代表了一系列成就——从让宇航员重返月球附近、扩大在轨道上运行人工智能的能力，到加速实现在轨服务以及通过合作和收购扩大规模。这些决赛入围者反映了推动当今发展的创造力和雄心。

paras.en: Winners will be announced at the 2026 SpaceNews Icon Awards on Dec. 1 in Washington D.C., where we’ll celebrate their contributions and share the stories behind their successes. In addition to recognizing this year’s winners, Space Force Gen. Michael Guetlein, direct reporting program manager for Golden Dome for America, will join us for a keynote address.
paras.zh: 获奖者名单将于 12 月 1 日在华盛顿特区举行的 2026 年太空新闻偶像奖上公布，届时我们将庆祝他们的贡献并分享他们成功背后的故事。除了表彰今年的获奖者之外，美国金顶的直接报告项目经理、太空军上将迈克尔·盖特兰 (Michael Guetlein) 也将与我们一起发表主题演讲。

paras.en: Tickets are available now – register by Oct. 31 to take advantage of our early bird rate.
paras.zh: 门票现已发售——请在 10 月 31 日之前注册，以享受我们的早鸟价。

paras.en: Honoring individuals whose leadership and vision have left a lasting impact on the space industry, shaping exploration, national security and commercial growth for generations.
paras.zh: 表彰其领导力和远见对航天工业产生持久影响、影响几代人的探索、国家安全和商业增长的个人。

paras.en: Mark Dankberg. A satellite communications pioneer who co-founded Viasat and spent decades advancing high-capacity satellite broadband, helping reshape how satellite technology connects consumers, governments and businesses.
paras.zh: 马克·丹克伯格。卫星通信先驱，Viasat 的联合创始人，花费数十年时间推进高容量卫星宽带的发展，帮助重塑卫星技术连接消费者、政府和企业的方式。

paras.en: Jean-Yves Le Gall. One of Europe’s most influential space leaders, with decades of leadership at CNES and Arianespace that helped strengthen Europe’s launch capabilities, international partnerships and position in the global space economy.
paras.zh: 让-伊夫·勒加尔。欧洲最具影响力的太空领导者之一，在法国国家空间研究中心和阿丽亚娜航天公司拥有数十年的领导地位，帮助加强了欧洲的发射能力、国际合作伙伴关系以及在全球太空经济中的地位。

paras.en: Chris Scolese. Capped a career spanning NASA and national security space after nearly seven years as director of the National Reconnaissance Office, where he oversaw a transformation of the agency’s architecture and growing integration of commercial capabilities. Scolese previously served as NASA’s chief engineer and director of Goddard Space Flight Center.
paras.zh: 克里斯·斯科莱斯。在担任国家侦察办公室主任近七年后，他在美国宇航局和国家安全领域的职业生涯结束了，在那里他监督了该机构架构的转型和商业能力的不断整合。斯科莱斯此前曾担任美国宇航局总工程师和戈达德太空飞行中心主任。

paras.en: Karen St. Germain. Helped shape NASA’s Earth science enterprise through senior leadership roles overseeing missions, research and the use of satellite observations to better understand Earth’s climate and environment.
paras.zh: 凯伦·圣日耳曼。通过监督任务、研究和卫星观测使用的高级领导角色，帮助塑造美国宇航局的地球科学事业，以更好地了解地球的气候和环境。

paras.en: Coyote Smith. A longtime military space leader and educator whose career has helped shape thinking about spacepower, national security space strategy and the development of the next generation of space professionals.
paras.zh: 郊狼·史密斯。一位长期的军事太空领导者和教育家，其职业生涯帮助塑造了对太空力量、国家安全太空战略和下一代太空专业人员发展的思考。

paras.en: Recognizing partnerships that bring together organizations and nations to advance space exploration, science and commerce.
paras.zh: 认可将组织和国家聚集在一起推动太空探索、科学和商业的伙伴关系。

paras.en: Clay Mowry. Now chief executive of the American Institute of Aeronautics and Astronautics (AIAA), he has worked across industry, government and professional organizations to build connections within an increasingly international and multidisciplinary space community.
paras.zh: 克莱·莫里。他现任美国航空航天学会 (AIAA) 首席执行官，曾在行业、政府和专业组织中工作，在日益国际化和多学科的太空社区中建立联系。

paras.en: Loft Orbital–Marlan Space. U.S.-French and Emirati capabilities joined in a major international space initiative, including plans for the 50-satellite Altair-Next Gen constellation combining Earth observation, onboard computing and artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 阁楼轨道——马兰空间。美国、法国和阿联酋联合参与了一项重大国际太空计划，其中包括由 50 颗卫星组成的 Altair-Next Gen 星座计划，该星座结合了地球观测、机载计算和人工智能。

paras.en: K2 Space–SES. Paired K2 Space’s high-power satellite platforms with SES’s software-defined payloads for meoSphere, a next-generation MEO network beginning with 28 spacecraft and designed to serve commercial and defense customers.
paras.zh: K2 空间——SES。将 K2 Space 的高功率卫星平台与 SES 软件定义的 meoSphere 有效载荷配对，meoSphere 是下一代 MEO 网络，从 28 颗航天器开始，旨在为商业和国防客户提供服务。

paras.en: Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope. Brought together NASA, ESA, JAXA, France’s CNES, Germany’s Max Planck Institute for Astronomy and institutions across the scientific community to develop a next-generation observatory for studying dark energy, exoplanets and the evolution of the universe. Roman launched Aug. 30, beginning a new chapter in international space science.
paras.zh: 南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜。美国宇航局、欧空局、日本宇宙航空研究开发机构、法国国家空间研究中心、德国马克斯·普朗克天文研究所以及整个科学界的机构聚集在一起，开发下一代天文台，用于研究暗能量、系外行星和宇宙演化。 Roman 于 8 月 30 日发射升空，开启了国际空间科学的新篇章。

paras.en: SMILE. The Solar wind Magnetosphere Ionosphere Link Explorer brought ESA and the Chinese Academy of Sciences together for the first mission jointly designed, implemented, launched and operated by Europe and China. The spacecraft launched May 19 to study the interaction between the solar wind and Earth’s magnetosphere.
paras.zh: 微笑。太阳风磁层电离层链接探测器将欧空局和中国科学院联合起来，执行欧洲和中国联合设计、实施、发射和运营的首次任务。该航天器于 5 月 19 日发射升空，旨在研究太阳风与地球磁层之间的相互作用。

paras.en: Recognizing new or rapidly growing companies driving innovation and opening new markets in the space economy.
paras.zh: 认可在太空经济中推动创新和开辟新市场的新公司或快速成长的公司。

paras.en: Benoît Deper / Aerospacelab. Built Aerospacelab into a rapidly expanding European satellite manufacturer and operator, pursuing vertically integrated spacecraft production and constellation development from Europe and the United States.
paras.zh: 伯努瓦·德佩 / 航空航天实验室。将航空航天实验室打造成一家快速扩张的欧洲卫星制造商和运营商，追求欧洲和美国垂直整合的航天器生产和星座开发。

paras.en: Lux Aeterna. Emerged from stealth with plans to develop reusable satellites capable of returning payloads to Earth, raising $10 million in 2026 as it works toward its first reentry demonstration mission.
paras.zh: 永恒之光。该公司计划开发能够将有效载荷返回地球的可重复使用卫星，并在 2026 年筹集 1000 万美元，以实现首次再入演示任务。

paras.en: Katalyst Space Technologies. Pushed commercial satellite servicing into new territory with LINK, a rapidly developed robotic spacecraft sent to attempt the rescue of NASA’s Swift observatory, while expanding into GEO servicing, deorbiting and other robotic space operations.
paras.zh: 催化剂空间技术。 LINK 是一种快速开发的机器人航天器，被派去尝试救援 NASA 的雨燕天文台，将商业卫星服务推向新领域，同时扩展到 GEO 服务、离轨和其他机器人太空操作。

paras.en: Skyroot Aerospace. Advanced India’s growing private launch sector with Vikram-1, India’s first privately developed orbital-class launch vehicle.
paras.zh: 天根航空航天公司。 Vikram-1 是印度第一个私人开发的轨道级运载火箭，推动印度不断发展的私人发射领域。

paras.en: Recognizing technologies that push the boundaries of engineering and create new capabilities for space operations.
paras.zh: 认识到突破工程界限并为太空作战创造新能力的技术。

paras.en: Cailabs. Advanced laser communications from individual optical ground stations toward shared infrastructure, launching an optical-ground-station-as-a-service model with plans for an international network of roughly 15 stations.
paras.zh: 凯拉布斯。从单个光学地面站到共享基础设施的先进激光通信，推出了光学地面站即服务模型，并计划建立一个由大约 15 个站组成的国际网络。

paras.en: D-Orbit. Continued expanding the capabilities of its ION orbital transfer vehicle beyond satellite deployment into hosted payloads, orbital transportation, cloud computing and other in-space logistics services.
paras.zh: D 轨道。继续将 ION 轨道传输飞行器的功能扩展到卫星部署之外，扩展到托管有效载荷、轨道运输、云计算和其他太空物流服务。

paras.en: Xona Space Systems. Advanced a commercial alternative to traditional GPS with Pulsar, a low Earth orbit positioning, navigation and timing architecture designed to provide more precise, resilient navigation services from a new generation of satellites.
paras.zh: 希纳空间系统公司。 Pulsar 是一种低地球轨道定位、导航和授时架构，旨在通过新一代卫星提供更精确、更有弹性的导航服务，从而推出传统 GPS 的商业替代品。

paras.en: Recognizing individuals whose leadership and innovation have set new benchmarks for excellence and inspired progress across the space community.
paras.zh: 表彰其领导力和创新能力为卓越树立新基准并激励整个航天界进步的个人。

paras.en: Steve Altemus, Intuitive Machines. Continued expanding Intuitive Machines from lunar transportation into a broader space infrastructure company, including the $800 million acquisition of Lanteris Space Systems and investments in communications, navigation and data services.
paras.zh: 史蒂夫·阿尔特穆斯，《直觉机器》。继续将 Intuitive Machines 从月球运输扩展到更广泛的空间基础设施公司，包括以 8 亿美元收购 Lanteris Space Systems 以及对通信、导航和数据服务的投资。

paras.en: Ian Cinnamon, Apex. Helped establish a new model for satellite manufacturing at Apex, emphasizing standardized spacecraft platforms, faster production and an approach designed to bring mass-production economics to the satellite industry.
paras.zh: 伊恩·肉桂，Apex。帮助 Apex 建立卫星制造的新模式，强调标准化航天器平台、更快的生产以及旨在为卫星行业带来大规模生产经济效益的方法。

paras.en: Rafal Modrzewski, Iceye. Led Iceye’s continued expansion of the world’s largest commercial synthetic aperture radar satellite fleet, combining commercial services with increasingly important sovereign intelligence capabilities for governments around the world.
paras.zh: 拉法尔·莫杰夫斯基，冰眼。 LED Iceye 持续扩大全球最大的商业合成孔径雷达卫星群，将商业服务与对世界各国政府日益重要的主权情报能力结合起来。

paras.en: Shey Sabripour, CesiumAstro. Built CesiumAstro around advanced active phased-array communications technology, helping move high-throughput, software-defined connectivity from a promising technology toward operational space systems.
paras.zh: Shey Saripour，CesiumAstro。围绕先进的有源相控阵通信技术构建 CesiumAstro，帮助将高吞吐量、软件定义的连接从有前景的技术转向可操作的空间系统。

paras.en: Recognizing transactions and investments that reshape markets, create new competitors or alter the trajectory of the space industry.
paras.zh: 认可重塑市场、创造新竞争对手或改变航天工业轨迹的交易和投资。

paras.en: AE Industrial Partners–Rocketdyne. AE Industrial agreed to acquire a controlling interest in L3Harris’ Space Propulsion and Power Systems business, reviving the Rocketdyne name for a company whose propulsion heritage stretches back more than six decades.
paras.zh: AE 工业合作伙伴——Rocketdyne。 AE Industrial 同意收购 L3Harris 太空推进和动力系统业务的控股权，从而为一家其推进历史可追溯至六十多年前的公司重新启用 Rocketdyne 名称。

paras.en: EQT–Exolaunch. EQT agreed to acquire Exolaunch, giving the previously self-funded German launch integration and deployment company its first outside investment and resources to expand internationally and develop new services.
paras.zh: EQT-Exolaunch。 EQT 同意收购 Exolaunch，为这家之前自筹资金的德国发射集成和部署公司提供了第一笔外部投资和资源，以进行国际扩张和开发新服务。

paras.en: Intuitive Machines–Lanteris Space Systems. Intuitive Machines completed its $800 million acquisition of the former Maxar Space Systems, adding decades of satellite manufacturing experience as it seeks to become a vertically integrated space prime.
paras.zh: 直观机器——兰特里斯空间系统。 Intuitive Machines 完成了对前 Maxar Space Systems 的 8 亿美元收购，在其寻求成为垂直整合的太空巨头的过程中，增加了数十年的卫星制造经验。

paras.en: Katalyst Space Technologies–NASA. NASA turned to Katalyst for an unusually rapid commercial servicing mission designed to rendezvous with and raise the orbit of the agency’s Swift observatory, testing a new model for acquiring time-sensitive in-space services.
paras.zh: Katalyst 空间技术——美国宇航局。 NASA 向 Katalyst 寻求一项异常快速的商业服务任务，旨在与该机构的雨燕天文台交会并提升其轨道，测试一种获取时间敏感的太空服务的新模型。

paras.en: SpaceX IPO. SpaceX’s long-awaited public offering brought one of the world’s most valuable private companies to public markets in a landmark transaction for the commercial space sector.
paras.zh: SpaceX 首次公开募股。 SpaceX 期待已久的公开发行将世界上最有价值的私营公司之一带到了公开市场，这是商业航天领域具有里程碑意义的交易。

paras.en: Recognizing advances that harness artificial intelligence and high-performance computing to transform spacecraft, space data and operations.
paras.zh: 认识到利用人工智能和高性能计算来改变航天器、空间数据和操作的进步。

paras.en: Aethero. Launched its Phobos spacecraft with an NVIDIA-powered edge-computing module, demonstrating a platform designed for continuous onboard processing and compute-as-a-service applications.
paras.zh: 埃泰罗。推出了配备 NVIDIA 驱动的边缘计算模块的 Phobos 航天器，展示了一个专为连续机载处理和计算即服务应用程序而设计的平台。

paras.en: Alex Greenberg, Loft Orbital. Helped drive Loft Orbital’s push to bring artificial intelligence and high-performance computing directly into orbit, enabling satellites to process increasingly large volumes of data before sending actionable information to the ground.
paras.zh: 亚历克斯·格林伯格，阁楼轨道。帮助推动 Loft Orbital 推动人工智能和高性能计算直接进入轨道，使卫星能够在向地面发送可操作信息之前处理越来越多的数据。

paras.en: Starcloud. Advanced the emerging concept of space-based data centers by developing high-performance orbital computing infrastructure intended to run increasingly demanding AI workloads in space.
paras.zh: 星云.通过开发旨在在太空中运行要求日益严格的人工智能工作负载的高性能轨道计算基础设施，推进新兴的天基数据中心概念。

paras.en: Recognizing companies and missions that have advanced commercial space capabilities and contributed to the growth of the space economy.
paras.zh: 表彰具有先进商业航天能力并为航天经济增长做出贡献的公司和任务。

paras.en: Iceye. Expanded its synthetic aperture radar network while deploying a new generation of spacecraft capable of imagery down to 16-centimeter resolution and supporting both commercial and sovereign missions worldwide.
paras.zh: 冰眼。扩大其合成孔径雷达网络，同时部署能够将图像分辨率低至 16 厘米的新一代航天器，并支持全球商业和主权任务。

paras.en: Impulse Space and Starfish Space. Demonstrated autonomous rendezvous and proximity operations using Impulse Space’s Mira spacecraft and Starfish Space technology, advancing commercial capabilities needed for future satellite servicing and other in-space operations.
paras.zh: 脉冲空间和海星空间。使用 Impulse Space 的 Mira 航天器和 Starfish Space 技术展示了自主交会和邻近操作，提高了未来卫星服务和其他太空操作所需的商业能力。

paras.en: SEOPS and Exolaunch. Expanded launch integration and rideshare services at a time of growing demand for alternatives in the commercial launch market, helping satellite operators secure access to orbit across a broader range of launch vehicles.
paras.zh: SEOPS 和 Exolaunch。在商业发射市场对替代品的需求不断增长之际，扩大了发射集成和乘车共享服务，帮助卫星运营商确保更广泛的运载火箭进入轨道。

paras.en: Recognizing leadership in using space technology to protect Earth and advancing more sustainable operations in space.
paras.zh: 认可在利用空间技术保护地球和推进更可持续的太空运营方面的领导地位。

paras.en: Hydrosat. Expanded the use of thermal infrared satellite data for water, agriculture and climate applications while unveiling Osiris, a next-generation constellation designed to combine 25-meter thermal imagery with broad-area coverage and daily revisit.
paras.zh: 海德萨特。扩大了热红外卫星数据在水、农业和气候应用中的使用，同时推出了 Osiris，这是一个下一代星座，旨在将 25 米热图像与大面积覆盖和每日重访相结合。

paras.en: Space Data Association. Continued bringing satellite operators together to share operational data and promote collision avoidance, responsible operations and sustainable use of increasingly congested orbital environments.
paras.zh: 空间数据协会。继续将卫星运营商聚集在一起，共享运行数据并促进避免碰撞、负责任的运行和可持续利用日益拥挤的轨道环境。

paras.en: Vera C. Rubin Observatory. Began issuing real-time scientific alerts in February, creating a system expected to eventually generate millions of alerts each night about changing objects and events ranging from asteroids to supernovae.
paras.zh: 维拉·C·鲁宾天文台。从二月份开始发布实时科学警报，创建了一个系统，预计最终将在每晚生成数百万个关于从小行星到超新星等物体和事件变化的警报。

paras.en: Celebrating breakthroughs in exploration, science and public-sector space missions.
paras.zh: 庆祝探索、科学和公共部门太空任务方面的突破。

paras.en: Artemis 2 Team. Returned astronauts to the vicinity of the moon for the first time in more than half a century, carrying NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover and Christina Koch and Canadian astronaut Jeremy Hansen on a nearly 10-day flight around the moon aboard Orion. The April mission brought together NASA, international partners and a vast industrial team supporting Orion, the Space Launch System and ground systems.
paras.zh: 阿尔忒弥斯2小队。半个多世纪以来，宇航员首次返回月球附近，美国宇航局宇航员里德·怀斯曼、维克多·格洛弗、克里斯蒂娜·科赫以及加拿大宇航员杰里米·汉森乘坐猎户座飞船进行了近 10 天的绕月飞行。四月份的任务汇集了美国宇航局、国际合作伙伴以及支持猎户座、太空发射系统和地面系统的庞大工业团队。

paras.en: Copernicus Sentinel-1D Team. Brought Sentinel-1D into full operations in May, restoring and strengthening Europe’s flagship radar Earth observation capability and continuing more than a decade of global environmental monitoring through Copernicus.
paras.zh: 哥白尼哨兵-1D 团队。 Sentinel-1D 于 5 月全面投入运行，恢复和加强了欧洲旗舰雷达地球观测能力，并通过哥白尼继续进行了十多年的全球环境监测。

paras.en: Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope Team. Successfully launched NASA’s next flagship astrophysics observatory Aug. 30, beginning a mission designed to survey the universe far faster than Hubble while investigating dark energy, exoplanets and some of astronomy’s biggest unanswered questions.
paras.zh: 南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜团队。 8 月 30 日成功发射了 NASA 的下一个旗舰天体物理观测站，开始了一项旨在以比哈勃望远镜快得多的速度观测宇宙的任务，同时研究暗能量、系外行星和一些天文学上尚未解答的最大问题。

paras.en: Recognizing individuals, organizations and missions making significant contributions to national security space capabilities.
paras.zh: 表彰对国家安全太空能力做出重大贡献的个人、组织和任务。

paras.en: Gurpartap “GP” Sandhoo. Took leadership of the Space Development Agency while also becoming the Space Force’s portfolio acquisition executive for missile warning and tracking, overseeing deployment of the Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture and its growing constellation of military satellites.
paras.zh: 古尔帕塔普·“GP”·桑胡。领导太空发展局，同时还成为太空部队负责导弹预警和跟踪的采购主管，监督扩散战士太空架构及其不断增长的军事卫星群的部署。

paras.en: Impulse Space. Expanded its national security role with a $28 million Space Force contract for a future space domain awareness mission using its highly maneuverable Mira spacecraft in low Earth orbit.
paras.zh: 脉冲空间。通过一份价值 2800 万美元的太空部队合同，扩大了其在国家安全方面的作用，该合同将使用其高度机动的 Mira 航天器在近地轨道上执行未来的太空领域感知任务。

paras.en: SpaceWERX. Continued using the Space Force’s small-business innovation programs to move emerging commercial technologies toward military applications and broaden the pool of companies contributing to national security space.
paras.zh: SpaceWERX。继续利用太空军的小型企业创新计划，将新兴商业技术推向军事应用，并扩大为国家安全领域做出贡献的公司群体。

paras.en: VICTUS HAZE Team. Demonstrated the Space Force’s most advanced tactically responsive space mission to date, with Rocket Lab and True Anomaly spacecraft supporting realistic rendezvous and proximity operations and space domain awareness scenarios after a rapid-response launch campaign.
paras.zh: VICTUS HAZE 团队。展示了太空军迄今为止最先进的战术响应太空任务，火箭实验室和真实异常航天器在快速响应发射活动后支持现实的交会和接近操作以及空间域感知场景。

paras.en: Join us for the 2026 SpaceNews Icon Awards in Washington, D.C., on Dec. 1.
paras.zh: 请与我们一起参加 12 月 1 日在华盛顿特区举行的 2026 年太空新闻偶像奖。

articles.title: Oct. 29: Applying AI to the GEOINT Mission
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: Artificial intelligence is changing how intelligence organizations collect, process and exploit satellite imagery. As the volume of Earth observation data grows, AI is becoming essential for identifying patterns, detecting anomalies and delivering intelligence at operational speed.
paras.zh: 人工智能正在改变情报组织收集、处理和利用卫星图像的方式。随着地球观测数据量的增长，人工智能对于识别模式、检测异常和以运行速度提供情报变得至关重要。

paras.en: Join SpaceNews and Vantor on Oct. 29 for a virtual event that will explore how machine learning is transforming the GEOINT mission across defense, intelligence and commercial markets.
paras.zh: 10 月 29 日与 SpaceNews 和 Vantor 一起参加虚拟活动，探讨机器学习如何改变国防、情报和商业市场的 GEOINT 任务。

paras.en: Speakers will discuss advances in automated target recognition, change detection, multimodal data fusion and large language models, as well as the challenges of validating AI outputs and maintaining analyst trust. The conversation will consider where AI delivers its greatest operational value, where humans remain indispensable and how intelligence organizations can adapt to persistent, data-driven surveillance.
paras.zh: 演讲者将讨论自动目标识别、变化检测、多模式数据融合和大型语言模型方面的进展，以及验证人工智能输出和维持分析师信任的挑战。对话将考虑人工智能在哪些方面发挥最大的运营价值、人类在哪些方面仍然不可或缺，以及情报组织如何适应持续的、数据驱动的监视。

paras.en: - Peter Wilczynski, chief product officer, Vantor
paras.zh: - Peter Wilczynski，Vantor 首席产品官

paras.en: - Joe O’Callaghan, director, Super Intelligence (SI) Mission, National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency
paras.zh: - Joe O’Callaghan，国家地理空间情报局超级情报 (SI) 任务主任

paras.en: - Matt Maroofi, senior director of product, Shield AI
paras.zh: - Matt Maroofi，Shield AI 产品高级总监

paras.en: This virtual event will take place via Zoom. You will receive a unique link to join with your registration confirmation. A recording will be posted here shortly after the event concludes.
paras.zh: 该虚拟活动将通过 Zoom 进行。您将收到一个独特的加入链接以及您的注册确认信息。活动结束后不久将在此处发布录音。

paras.en: Vantor is forging the new frontier of spatial intelligence to unlock a more autonomous, interoperable world. We give decision makers and operators the power to build a unified intelligence picture, delivering the clarity they need to navigate what’s happening now and shape what’s coming next. We fuse data from our constellation, which includes the most capable imaging satellites on orbit, with real-time sensor feeds from space, air, and ground to create an AI-ready digital twin of Earth. Our spatial intelligence platform automates every part of the cycle—from tasking to collection to production—to update and analyze this foundation at the pace of change. Our products drive deeper mission-critical insights and connect the next generation of autonomous systems across the defense, intelligence, and commercial landscape. To learn more, visit www.vantor.com
paras.zh: Vantor 正在开拓空间智能的新领域，以解锁一个更加自主、可互操作的世界。我们使决策者和操作员能够构建统一的情报图景，为他们提供所需的清晰度，以引导当前正在发生的事情并塑造接下来的情况。我们将来自我们的星座（包括在轨成像卫星）的数据与来自太空、空中和地面的实时传感器反馈相融合，创建一个支持人工智能的地球数字孪生。我们的空间智能平台可自动化周期的每个部分（从任务分配到收集再到生产），以根据变化的速度更新和分析这一基础。我们的产品推动更深入的关键任务洞察，并连接国防、情报和商业领域的下一代自主系统。要了解更多信息，请访问 www.vantor.com

articles.title: Rangers miss chance to go top as Jones earns Dundee a point

paras.en: Dundee 2-2 Rangers: Callum Jones scores second-half equaliser as Rangers miss chance to replace Celtic at top of Scottish Premiership
paras.zh: 邓迪 2-2 流浪者队：卡勒姆·琼斯下半场扳平比分，流浪者队错失了取代凯尔特人队登顶苏超的机会

paras.en: Report as Rangers draw 2-2 at Dundee; home side went ahead through Bradley Fink, but Badredine Bouanani hits back for Rangers before half-time; Nico Raskin scores brilliant goal from distance to put Rangers ahead but Callum Jones equalises to earn Dundee a point
paras.zh: 报道流浪者队2-2战平邓迪；主队凭借布拉德利·芬克（Bradley Fink）取得领先，但半场结束前巴德雷丁·博瓦纳尼（Badredine Bouanani）为流浪者队反击；尼科·拉斯金 (Nico Raskin) 远距离进球帮助流浪者队领先，但卡勒姆·琼斯 (Callum Jones) 扳平比分，为邓迪队赢得一分

paras.en: Callum Jones scored a second-half equaliser as Rangers were held to a 2-2 draw by Dundee and missed the chance to go top of the Scottish Premiership.
paras.zh: 下半场卡勒姆·琼斯扳平比分，流浪者队2-2战平邓迪队，错失了登顶苏超的机会。

paras.en: Dundee opened the scoring when Rangers failed to deal with a routine long ball, with Bradley Fink capitalising to round the goalkeeper and slide home.
paras.zh: 当流浪者队未能处理例行长传时，邓迪首开纪录，布拉德利·芬克利用绕过门将并滑入球门。

paras.en: The lead did not last long, though, as Badredine Bouanani cut inside and curled in a stunning equaliser to open his account for Rangers.
paras.zh: 然而领先优势并没有持续太久，巴德雷丁·布阿纳尼内切并打入一记令人惊叹的扳平比分，为流浪者队打开了局面。

paras.en: - Watch FREE Scottish Prem highlights | Latest Scottish Prem news | Latest scores
paras.zh: - 免费观看苏格兰Prem 精彩集锦|最新的苏格兰Prem新闻|最新成绩

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream the Scottish Prem with no contract
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新的天空体育交易或无合同的苏格兰Prem直播

paras.en: Nico Raskin scored the goal of the game when his shot from outside the area went in off the underside of the crossbar.
paras.zh: 尼科·拉斯金禁区外的射门从横梁下方射入，打进了本场比赛的进球。

paras.en: But Jones then caught Dan Neil dwelling on the ball and nicked it off the Rangers captain to slot home the Dundee equaliser.
paras.zh: 但琼斯随后抓住了丹·尼尔的注意力，并将球从流浪者队队长手中抢断，为邓迪队扳平比分。

paras.en: Rangers remain second and move one point behind Celtic, who host Hearts live on Sky Sports on Sunday from 2.30pm.
paras.zh: 流浪者队仍排名第二，落后凯尔特人队一分，凯尔特人队将于周日下午 2 点 30 分在天空体育直播主场迎战红心队。

paras.en: 8: BLOCKED! Kim has a shot blocked with the goal gaping. Rangers cry for handball but nothing doing.
paras.zh: 8：被封锁！金的射门被挡出，球门空了。流浪者队因手球而哭泣，但没有采取任何行动。

paras.en: 14: SHOT! Forrest drives from midfield and shoots from the outside of the area, but Pandur gathers comfortably.
paras.zh: 14：开枪！福雷斯特从中场带球，在禁区外射门，但潘杜尔轻松接球。

paras.en: 23: SHOT! Hay has a speculative shot and again it's saved comfortably by Pandur.
paras.zh: 23：开枪！海伊（Hay）投出一脚投机性射门，再次被潘杜尔（Pandur）轻松扑出。

paras.en: 28: SAVE! Hamilton whips a free kick across and Astley heads towards goal from outside of the area tipped behind by Pandur.
paras.zh: 28：保存！汉密尔顿开出任意球，阿斯特利在禁区外头球攻门，潘杜尔将球顶在身后。

paras.en: 29: OFF THE BAR! Hay leaps to meet the corner and it rattles the bar.
paras.zh: 29：离开酒吧！干草跳到拐角处，把吧台弄得嘎嘎作响。

paras.en: 36: CLOSE! Hamilton takes an early shot after Dundee win the ball back and it goes just wide.
paras.zh: 36：关闭！邓迪队夺回球权后，汉密尔顿早早射门，但球稍稍偏出。

paras.en: 37: GOAL! Fink rounds the goalkeeper and scores!
paras.zh: 37：目标！芬克绕过门将得分！

paras.en: 42: GOAL! Bouanani curls into the top corner for his first goal for Rangers!
paras.zh: 42：目标！布瓦纳尼将球打入上角，这是他在流浪者队的第一个进球！

paras.en: 56: SAVE! Gassama shoots from the edge of the area, and it's saved one-handed by the 'keeper
paras.zh: 56：保存！加萨马禁区边缘射门，被门将单手扑出

paras.en: 60: GOAL! Nico Raskin scores a screamer off the bar from outside of the area.
paras.zh: 60：目标！尼科·拉斯金禁区外的一脚尖叫击中横梁。

paras.en: 69: GOAL! Neil dwells on the ball and is dispossessed by Jones who slots past the goalkeeper to get Dundee level!
paras.zh: 69：目标！尼尔专注于球，被琼斯抢断，琼斯越过了门将，将邓迪扳平！

paras.en: 74: CLOSE! Ball falls to Neil in the six-yard box but Dundee somehow scramble the ball clear!
paras.zh: 74：关闭！球落在六码禁区内的尼尔手中，但邓迪以某种方式将球解围！

paras.en: McInnes: We shouldn't need three goals to win
paras.zh: 麦金尼斯：我们不需要三个进球才能获胜

paras.en: "I thought Dundee's press was good, as expected, and we wanted to try and draw the centre-backs out at times and try and hit spaces and feed our wide players and try and get 1v1.
paras.zh: “我认为邓迪的逼抢很好，正如预期的那样，我们想尝试时不时地吸引中后卫，尝试突破空位，喂给我们的边路球员，尝试实现1v1。

paras.en: "We shouldn't need to come away from home and need to score three goals to win a game.
paras.zh: “我们不需要客场作战，需要进三个球才能赢得一场比赛。

paras.en: "Two goals should have been enough tonight. We had a few chances when it went to two each.
paras.zh: “今晚进两个球应该就足够了。当双方各进两球时，我们有一些机会。

paras.en: "Dundee are a good team, but I think we gifted an opportunity there not to take all three points.
paras.zh: “邓迪是一支优秀的球队，但我认为我们在那里提供了一个没有全取三分的机会。

paras.en: "We're disappointed not to come away with three points."
paras.zh: “我们很失望没有拿下三分。”

paras.en: Pressley: We showed grit and determination
paras.zh: 普莱斯利：我们表现出了勇气和决心

paras.en: "I thought we were outstanding in the first half, really aggressive, controlled a lot of the game.
paras.zh: “我认为我们上半场表现出色，非常有侵略性，控制了很多比赛。

paras.en: "We were really strong on second balls, had one or two moments where we should have capitalised and restricted Rangers to very little.
paras.zh: “我们在第二球上确实很强，有一两个时刻我们应该利用并限制流浪者队的进攻。

paras.en: "We obviously expected a reaction from Rangers and they gave that reaction. They put us under a lot of pressure in the second half.
paras.zh: “我们显然期待流浪者队的反应，他们也做出了这样的反应。他们在下半场给我们带来了很大的压力。

paras.en: "The game was getting away from us but we never gave up, we kept going and going and (Callum) Jones got his reward for a really strong performance today."
paras.zh: “比赛离我们越来越远，但我们从未放弃，我们继续前进，（卡勒姆）琼斯今天的出色表现得到了回报。”

paras.en: "Dundee are a good team. They're not there [in the table] by fluke or luck.
paras.zh: “邓迪是一支优秀的球队。他们进入积分榜并不是侥幸或运气。

paras.en: "They've got a style of play, Steven Pressley has got a group of players willing to run themselves into the ground for him and that's hard to get.
paras.zh: “他们有自己的比赛风格，史蒂文·普莱斯利有一群愿意为他拼尽全力的球员，这是很难得到的。

paras.en: "They put in a shift and even when they're asked to dig in and suffer like they did for the first 20/25 minutes of that second half.
paras.zh: “他们进行了轮班，甚至当他们被要求埋头苦干时，就像他们在下半场前 20/25 分钟所做的那样。

paras.en: "They then got a second wind and came back at Rangers and asked questions of them.
paras.zh: “然后他们又恢复了活力，回到流浪者队并向他们询问了问题。

paras.en: "A draw was a fair result. It took wonder strikes to get Rangers two goals.
paras.zh: “平局是一个公平的结果。流浪者队需要神奇的进球才能取得两个进球。

paras.en: "There was a lack of creativity at the top end of the pitch and it's something they're going to have to improve."
paras.zh: “球场顶端缺乏创造力，这是他们必须改进的地方。”

articles.title: Van Gerwen suffers another early exit as Van Veen makes history

paras.en: Dutch Darts Championship: Michael van Gerwen suffers another early exit as Gian van Veen makes history and Gerwyn Price triumphs on return
paras.zh: 荷兰飞镖锦标赛：迈克尔·范·格文再次提前出局，吉安·范·维恩创造历史，格温·普莱斯回归获胜

paras.en: Michael van Gerwen's poor form in 2026 continues as he suffers second-round Dutch Darts Championship defeat to Williams O'Connor; Gerwyn Price, Gian van Veen, Stephen Bunting, Nathan Aspinall each progress; watch Grand Slam of Darts live on Sky Sports from November 14-22
paras.zh: 迈克尔·范格文 (Michael van Gerwen) 2026 年的糟糕状态仍在继续，他在荷兰飞镖锦标赛第二轮输给了威廉姆斯·奥康纳 (Williams O'Connor)；格文·普莱斯 (Gerwyn Price)、吉安·范·维恩 (Gian van Veen)、史蒂芬·邦廷 (Stephen Bunting)、内森·阿斯皮纳尔 (Nathan Aspinall) 各有进步； 11 月 14 日至 22 日在天空体育观看飞镖大满贯直播

paras.en: Dutch favourite Michael van Gerwen suffered a shock second-round exit at the Dutch Darts Championship on Saturday, losing 6-5 to Irishman William O'Connor.
paras.zh: 荷兰选手迈克尔·范格文周六在荷兰飞镖锦标赛第二轮令人震惊地出局，以 6-5 输给爱尔兰选手威廉·奥康纳。

paras.en: The defeat extends Van Gerwen's poor run of form, having lost his opening match at four European Tour events this season before arriving in Maastricht: the European Darts Trophy, German Darts Grand Prix, Flanders Darts Trophy and Swiss Darts Trophy. It marks his most first-round exits in a single season since the tour began in 2012.
paras.zh: 这次失利延续了范格文糟糕的状态，他在抵达马斯特里赫特之前在本赛季的四场欧巡赛首场比赛中失利：欧洲飞镖杯、德国飞镖大奖赛、佛兰德斯飞镖杯和瑞士飞镖杯。这是他自2012年巡回赛开始以来单赛季首轮出局次数最多的一次。

paras.en: O'Connor produced a superb display, firing in three ton-plus checkouts of 136, 131 and 121 to seal his victory and book his place in round three.
paras.zh: 奥康纳表现出色，以 136、131 和 121 的三吨以上成绩锁定了胜利，并锁定了第三轮的席位。

paras.en: Elsewhere on Saturday, Gerwyn Price's return to the stage ended in glory as he beat Scott Williams 6-3, while Gian van Veen broke the European Tour record average.
paras.zh: 周六的其他比赛中，格温·普莱斯 (Gerwyn Price) 重返舞台以 6-3 击败斯科特·威廉姆斯 (Scott Williams) 的荣耀结束，而吉安·范维恩 (Gian van Veen) 则打破了欧洲巡回赛的平均纪录。

paras.en: Van Veen averaged a staggering 120.24 in whitewashing Sebastian Bialecki, breaking the previous record of 118.66 by Dave Chisnall.
paras.zh: 范维恩在粉饰塞巴斯蒂安·比亚莱茨基的比赛中取得了惊人的120.24分，打破了戴夫·奇斯纳尔之前保持的118.66分的记录。

paras.en: Schindler sealed his spot at the European Championships later this month with his victory over Karel Sedlacek.
paras.zh: 本月晚些时候，辛德勒战胜卡雷尔·塞德拉切克，锁定了欧洲锦标赛的席位。

paras.en: Bunting left it late to secure his place at the European Championship, beating already-qualified Cameron Menzies 6-2 to book his spot. The former Masters champion needed a strong finish to get over the line.
paras.zh: 邦廷在最后时刻以 6-2 击败已经晋级的卡梅伦·孟席斯，确保了自己的欧洲锦标赛席位。这位前大师赛冠军需要强劲的表现才能冲过终点线。

paras.en: The 41-year-old pinned six out of ten attempts at the outer ring in his victory over the Scot, and jumped into the qualifying places, knocking Kim Huybrechts out of the running.
paras.zh: 这位 41 岁的选手在战胜苏格兰人的比赛中，在外圈十次尝试中六次成功，并跃升到排位赛位置，将金·休布莱希茨 (Kim Huybrechts) 淘汰出局。

paras.en: Brendan Dolan remains the only player capable of pushing Sedlacek out of the European Championship qualifying spots after beating Heine Uuldriks 6-4. The Northern Irishman had led 4-1 before being pegged back.
paras.zh: 布伦丹·多兰 (Brendan Dolan) 在以 6-4 击败海涅·乌德里克斯 (Heine Uuldriks) 后，仍然是唯一有能力将塞德拉切克 (Sedlacek) 挤出欧洲锦标赛资格的球员。北爱尔兰人在被追平之前以4-1领先。

paras.en: Nathan Aspinall ended Michael Smith's hopes of qualifying for Dortmund with a dominant 6-1 victory. The World Grand Prix semi-finalist averaged over 102 to dispatch the former world champion.
paras.zh: 内森·阿斯皮纳尔 (Nathan Aspinall) 以 6-1 的压倒性胜利终结了迈克尔·史密斯 (Michael Smith) 晋级多特蒙德的希望。这位世界大奖赛半决赛选手以场均超过102杆的成绩击败了前世界冠军。

paras.en: Wessel Nijman and Danny Noppert also secured their places in Sunday's action, with the Dutch pair defeating Jeffrey De Graaf and Dave Chisnall respectively.
paras.zh: 韦塞尔·尼曼（Wessel Nijman）和丹尼·诺珀特（Danny Noppert）也确保了周日比赛的席位，这对荷兰组合分别击败了杰弗里·德·格拉夫（Jeffrey De Graaf）和戴夫·奇斯纳尔（Dave Chisnall）。

paras.en: Niels Zonneveld edged a last-leg decider against Krzysztof Ratajski, hitting seven maximums for the second consecutive match to book his place in round three. Fellow Dutchman Jermaine Wattimena also progressed, beating Host Nation Qualifier Jimmy van Schie 6-2.
paras.zh: 尼尔斯·佐内维尔德在最后一回合的决胜局中击败了克日什托夫·拉塔伊斯基，连续第二场比赛打出七个最高分，从而锁定了第三轮的席位。荷兰同胞杰梅因·瓦蒂梅纳 (Jermaine Wattimena) 也晋级，以 6-2 击败东道主国预选赛选手吉米·范希伊 (Jimmy van Schie)。

paras.en: European Tour ranking leader Ross Smith will face Ryan Searle in round three after overcoming Ryan Joyce and Dirk van Duijvenbode respectively.
paras.zh: 欧巡赛排名领先的罗斯·史密斯将在第三轮分别战胜瑞安·乔伊斯和德克·范·杜伊文博德后，对阵瑞安·塞尔。

paras.en: Damon Heta averaged over 103 in a dominant 6-1 victory over Jonny Clayton, securing his first win against the Welshman since May last year.
paras.zh: 达蒙·赫塔 (Damon Heta) 场均得分超过 103 分，以 6-1 的优势战胜乔尼·克莱顿 (Jonny Clayton)，这是他自去年 5 月以来首次战胜威尔士人。

paras.en: Luke Woodhouse also booked his place in Sunday's action with a comfortable victory over Andrew Gilding.
paras.zh: 卢克·伍德豪斯（Luke Woodhouse）也轻松击败安德鲁·吉尔丁（Andrew Gilding），在周日的比赛中获得了席位。

paras.en: Cristo Reyes brought the evening's action to a close in style, averaging over 110 in a 6-2 win against Chris Dobey while converting 60 per cent of his attempts at double.
paras.zh: 克里斯托·雷耶斯 (Cristo Reyes) 以场均超过 110 分的出色表现结束了当晚的比赛，以 6-2 击败克里斯·多比 (Chris Dobey)，同时他的二垒安打命中率高达 60%。
